risks.risk: Human review and exact squash-merge provenance are not yet complete.
risks.mitigation: Keep the single PR Draft, prohibit auto-merge, fail closed on unexpected PR identity or lifecycle, and keep OA-01 blocked.

risks.risk: Local Node is v25.9.0 while the future canonical target is Node 24.18.0.
risks.mitigation: Record as a non-blocking governance-only validation variance and standardize before OA-01; do not change the toolchain in OA-00C.

risks.risk: Live GitHub metadata is an external dependency for lifecycle truth.
risks.mitigation: Pin stable PR identity in repository metadata, query live state, and fail closed when GitHub data is unavailable or inconsistent.

risks.risk: Consumer adoption sources could drift after their pinned commits.
risks.mitigation: Verify commit ancestry plus committed and uncommitted protected-source drift and exact hashes.
